title: Gallaudet co-writes the Bluegill Triple Prime report
place_text: Bluegill Triple Prime nuclear test site

tellings.quote: I helped Jeff Krookchank write the report on it.

plain: A retired Navy admiral named Tim Gallaudet says he helped write the report on Bluegill Triple Prime, a 1962 nuclear test. He says he wrote it with a man named Jeff Cruickshank. Gallaudet tells this himself, as someone who took part, and if it is true he knows first-hand what that report says.
